_readme: WHICH FILE PLAYS WHICH PART, decided per brand rather than guessed from a filename.
Keys are folder paths relative to the folder you point the importer at. Values name
the file for each role; a role you leave out is simply not set. Anything not listed
here falls back to the importer's own shape heuristics, so this file is an override
sheet, not a requirement. Edit it freely: it is read fresh on every run.
MISC folders are ignored everywhere, so nothing in one can be named here.

Gaming/Nintendo._note: The PNG is white_bg, which would sit as a white slab on a black page.

Gaming/PlayStation._note: The 4K black lockup is 16:9, so it reads as a plate rather than a cutout.

Streamer/Apple TV._note: Blk is the black-on-light lockup. Check it against the dark page.

Streamer/HBO Max._note: The JPEG is 4:3, so it crops hard in a 16:9 frame.

Streamer/Netflix._note: Symbol.png is the standalone N, portrait. Wrong shape for the mark slot.

Studios/WB Discovery._note: The 480x480 icon is the alternative if the banner sets too wide.

The Multiverse/DC._note: Key art only. The hub keeps the logo it already has, so the DC Studios mark was moved to MISC rather than named here.

The Multiverse/MARVEL._note: Key art only, same as DC. The existing mark stays.

The Multiverse/Star Wars._note: lucasfilmltd.png is the Lucasfilm mark, which is the studio, not this hub.
